data.seen_actions: Read actual continuation training_data.json actions, canonical template only. Do not sample a replacement training set.
data.test: Read original split.json test pairs. Expand report_current, report_goal, and action with the existing canonical/heldout prompts.

input: Original training-compatible input: same visible text graph, current and goal supplied by two adapter slots, original node-ID answer instruction.

scoring.actions: Report every legal distance-decreasing successor as correct, plus agreement with the one stored training label as a separate metric.
scoring.reports: Generated current/goal IDs and both-report correctness, without output grammar.
scoring.format: Original strict node-ID parser. Free output failures and token-limit hits reported separately; global node-ID grammar diagnoses formatting without revealing legal neighbors.

interpretation: Exploratory diagnosis of optimization, same-graph pair generalization, template transfer, and report retention. This substitution-format assessment is separate from the main matched full-text augmentation evaluation; it does not establish roadmap benefit over text. No optimization or checkpoint selection is performed.
